name: Cecil
source:
A woman who is the exclusive maid of the princess.
Quiet and cool impression. She always stands by the princess and does all her work perfectly.
Since she is also a bodyguard, her ability to fight is very great.

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842266&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
